identity.label: Supertonic 3
identity.description: Compact multilingual on-device TTS system with public ONNX assets, fixed voice styles, expression tags, and examples for Python, JavaScript, Swift, Rust, C++, Go, Java, C#, browser, Flutter, and iOS.

benchmark.tested_on_hardware: Apple Silicon macOS local Vox Jot managed Speech runtime
benchmark.output_quality_notes: Full Vox Jot hard TTS suite passed on 2026-05-12: score 98.6, 5/5 cases, average ASR round-trip WER 0.032, median WER 0.0, p50 latency 1588 ms, p50 RTF 0.143. Full style suite also passed: score 90.3, 6/6 cases, style proxy 0.9109, average ASR round-trip WER 0.0, p50 latency 1066 ms, p50 RTF 0.185. Supertonic does not support voice cloning, so no voice-clone row was added.

blockers: No streaming API exposed in upstream examples, so long readback is chunked rather than streamed
Model weights use OpenRAIL-M rather than Apache/MIT; product policy should preserve license notices and use restrictions
verdict.notes: Implemented as a Vox Jot managed Speech runtime provider with provider id 'supertonic' and model id 'supertonic-3'. The worker installs supertonic==1.2.1, loads the HF snapshot with auto_download=False, exposes M1-M5/F1-F5 preset voices, maps tempo_rate to Supertonic speed, maps quality_steps to denoising steps, and falls back unsupported locales to Supertonic's 'na' language token.
